193-2369-2724-8172.description:
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

225-4863-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-4863-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Revolutionist and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Revolutionist and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-4863-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Revolutionist and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1479-2841-3897-4862.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3897-4862.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Omnath and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Omnath trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1676-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

240-728-4785-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-4785-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

625-1978-7935.description:
Cause Gumato to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Gumato by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gumato.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

1170-1636-4113-7546.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Maestro's Gift using convoke without paying mana.
1170-1636-4113-7546.description:
Cast Maestro's Gift using Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Inspired Skypainter.
When Inspired Skypainter enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

475-3263-5641-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-3263-5641-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-850-955.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-955.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2499-3821-4770.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}.
2499-3821-4770.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

79-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Birthing Hulk, adding {C}{C}.
When Birthing Hulk dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Birthing Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Birthing Hulk enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

4091-5434-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

4658-7428.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Eternity has lifelink and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
4658-7428.description:
Deal combat damage using Soul of Eternity, doubling your life total due to its lifelink.
At the beginning of your end step, Defiling Daemogoth triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you've lost this turn.

2034-3220-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2034-3220-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Golgari Germination and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

560-1169-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

3317-5256-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3317-5256-5972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

4875-5331-6737.description:
Cast Gemcutter Buccaneer by paying {3}{R}. When it enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
When the Treasure enters, Barret triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token which enters as a Pirate due to Conspiracy.
When the Rebel enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
Repeat from step 2.
4875-5331-6737.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop in step 2. This must be stopped at some point or the game ends in a draw.

851-5525-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
851-5525-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Llanowar Loamspeaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1308-5702-6202.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1308-5702-6202.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with mana to cast it.
1308-5702-6202.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Noyan Dar
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

104-3490-4050-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4050-4716.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

413-539-7031.description:
Cast Badgermole by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Badgermole trigger, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Badgermole
When Badgermole dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

1894-2173-4446-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1894-2173-4446-5220.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

431-3129-4365-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-3129-4365-4772.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

440-1339-4050-6752.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-4050-6752.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

618-2292-6473.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mardu Siegebreaker.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Mardu Siegebreaker token.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

3617-6308.manaNeeded: {6} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
3617-6308.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conqueror's Foothold's fourth ability by paying {6} and tapping it, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

900-1007-1173-1984-3454.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{W}{W} on your first turn, with {6}{R}{R}{W}{W}{W}{W} available each other turn
900-1007-1173-1984-3454.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two white permanents.
Sunforger attached to a creature you control.
Sword of Feast and Famine attached to any creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
900-1007-1173-1984-3454.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Final Fortune and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Final Fortune, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Mistveil Plains by paying {W} and tapping it, putting Final Fortune on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to any creature you control.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Angel's Grace and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Angel's Grace, causing you to be unable to lose the game this turn.
Activate Mistveil Plains by paying {W} and tapping it, putting Angel's Grace on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Feast and Famine attached.
Sword of Feast and Famine triggers, causing the defending player to discard a card and you to untap all lands you control.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to any creature you control.
Repeat.

1309-1987-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1309-1987-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and Peregrine Drake.
When Salvager of Secrets and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1309-1987-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

744-1107-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional card in hand.
744-1107-2034.description:
Cast Rite of Harmony by paying {G}{W}.
Activate Pegasus Refuge by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Pegasus creature token.
When the Pegasus enters the battlefield, Rite of Harmony triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pegasus, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

803-935-4508-5184.description:
Activate Niv-Mizzet by paying {U}{R}, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Malcolm and Niv-Mizzet trigger.
Resolve the Niv-Mizzet trigger, allowing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Malcolm trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

3398-4711-4813.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Foragers does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Famished Foragers and Hellkite Charger.
 An opponent has lost life this turn.
3398-4711-4813.description:
Declare Famished Foragers as an attacker.
Hellkite Charger, Hellkite Charger's myriad ability, and Famished Foragers' myriad ability trigger.
Resolve the Famished Foragers trigger, creating at least three token copies of it that are tapped and attacking.
The Famished Foragers tokens enter the battlefield, adding at least nine {R}.
Resolve Hellkite Charger's myriad trigger, creating at least three token copies of it that are tapped and attacking.
Resolve the remaining Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Blade of Selves triggers, exiling the Famished Foragers tokens.
Repeat each combat phase.

1156-4013-4659.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Pia and Kiran.
Pia and Kiran enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Thopter creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the two Thopters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1605-3011-3333.easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
1605-3011-3333.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down then doubled, and causing it to deal no damage to you

914-3198-3636.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3198-3636.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Lore Drakkis's mutate ability triggers, returning Rescue from your graveyard to hand.
Cast Rescue by paying {U}, returning Dockside Extortionist and Lore Drakkis to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding {1}{U}{U/R}{U/R}{R}.
Repeat.
